Each novel sells for $4, and each magazine sells for $1. If Sadie purchased a total of 11&nbsp;novels and magazines that have a combined selling price of $20, how many novels did she purchase?\x3C/p>",rationale:"\x3Cp>Choice B is correct. Let \x3Cspan>n\x3C/span> be the number of novels and \x3Cem>m \x3C/em>be the number of magazines that Sadie purchased. If Sadie purchased a total of 11 novels and magazines, then \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"n plus m, equals 11\">\x3C/span>. It is given that the combined price of 11 novels and magazines is $20. Since each novel sells for $4 and each magazine sells for $1, it follows that \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"4 n plus m, equals 20\">\x3C/span>. So the system of equations below must hold.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>\x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"4 n plus m, equals 20; n plus m, equals 11\">\x3C/span>\x3C/p>\x3Cp>Subtracting corresponding sides of the second equation from the first equation yields \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"3 n equals 9\">\x3C/span>,&nbsp;so \x3Cspan>\x3Cimg align=\"middle\" role=\"math\" class=\"math-img\" src=\"data:image/png;base64,\" alt=\"n equals 3\">\x3C/span>. Therefore, Sadie purchased 3 novels.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>Choice A is incorrect. If 2 novels were purchased, then a total of $8 was spent on novels. That leaves $12 to be spent on magazines, which means that 12 magazines would have been purchased. However, Sadie purchased a total of 11 novels and magazines. Choices C and D are incorrect. If 4 novels were purchased, then a total of $16 was spent on novels. That leaves $4 to be spent on magazines, which means that 4 magazines would have been purchased. By the same logic, if Sadie purchased 5 novels, she would have no money at all ($0) to buy magazines. However, Sadie purchased a total of 11 novels and magazines.\x3C/p>\x3Cp>&nbsp;\x3C/p>\x3Cp>\x3C/p>"},answers:$R[4]=[$R[5]={id:17389,question:875270355,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp>2\x3C/p>\n"},$R[6]={id:17390,question:875270355,correct:!0,content:"\x3Cp>3\x3C/p>\n"},$R[7]={id:17391,question:875270355,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp>4\x3C/p>\n"},$R[8]={id:17392,question:875270355,correct:!1,content:"\x3Cp>5\x3C/p>\n"}],userData:void 0})($R["server-fn:0"]))
